# `sngl snapshot` on gtk4 builds the program for it, whose entry draws its
# first window at the size asked for into a file (sngl_gtk_capture_file).
# Built in C and in Go, the program draws its window alike, pixel for pixel.
# A program whose entry builds nothing has no window to draw, and writes no
# picture.

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'
[!headless] skip 'a display to draw in required'

sngl snapshot --force --width=300 --height=120 --out=shots c.sngl go.sngl
exists shots/c_gtk4.png
exists shots/go_gtk4.png
cmp shots/c_gtk4.png shots/go_gtk4.png

-- c.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    c {
        gtk4
    }
}

ui.window(title="Snapshot") {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="Hello from GTK")
        ui.button(text="Press")
        ui.checkbox(label="Check me")
    }
}
-- go.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        gtk4
    }
}

ui.window(title="Snapshot") {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="Hello from GTK")
        ui.button(text="Press")
        ui.checkbox(label="Check me")
    }
}
